title: This Animal Flicks Its Two-Foot Tongue 150 Times a Minute

scenes.text: This animal flicks a two-foot tongue one hundred fifty times a minute.
It's the giant anteater, and it has no teeth at all.
Its tongue is thin as spaghetti, with tiny spines and sticky saliva that catch insects.
Its claws tear open ant mounds, and the tongue does the rest.
In one day, it can eat up to thirty thousand ants and termites.

description:
A giant anteater can flick its two-foot tongue up to 150 times a minute.
It has no teeth, and its sticky tongue catches up to 30,000 ants and termites in a day.
Could you eat 30,000 ants?
first_comment: Bonus: it walks on its knuckles so its claws stay sharp. Which animal has the weirdest tongue?
